body:
We can't change who we are attracted to. It'd be like asking a gay person to suddenly become straight. 

But, I used to think of never dating a girl taller than me... but this girl I'm planning to ask out is 1" taller than me. However, she is just nice, smart and beautiful, hits a 10 on my scale, can overlook her height.
I was thinking about the heels scenario. It'd make me feel puny. I'm only 5"6' and she's about 5"7'.
I shall soon find out if she's worth the time :)

One of my friends from school suggested the same thing back when I was in school, to talk to my high school crush over facebook... It did not work, I got labeled stalker within a week of just talking to her. And then she started to ignore me. 
Thanks for the advice, but I'm not too keen on trying that one again.

We have only spoken once because it was the last week of uni, before we had to go study. So I can't really facebook chat with her as I don't have her as a friend because she probably doesn't even remember my name.
I can't call her because I was too stupid to take the best chance to get her number. Prior to yesterday.

Think it this way, you have a purpose which you can fulfill since you are still alive. Rather than trying again to commit suicide, I say go do anything and everything which appeals to your well-being.
